result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. In `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, I added `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` to the condition that adds an unmatched contributor to the remainder.

Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped. Configured teams are unchanged. Blank latest-commit dates already count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for them.

The module compiles. I didn't run or add any tests.
